name: Advanced Algorithm with Mipmap Fallback
aliases: Advanced Algorithm with Mipmap Fallback — Approximate Rendering with Mipmap Fallback, Second Display Mode
definition: An approximation method where missing data at the needed resolution triggers a fallback to a higher mipmap level, resorting to iterative interrupt/resume only if no higher level is present or data is too coarse.
summary: This streamed voxel rendering method maintains frame rate stability during camera motion by substituting missing data with coarser mipmap levels, prioritizing visual continuity over strict accuracy.
